steps.body: Subtraction is the same walk, reversed: start at the bigger number, jump backward, land on the difference.
steps.narration: Subtraction is the same walk, reversed: start at the bigger number, jump backward, land on the difference.

commonLandings.feedback: One backward ten so far — the subtraction asks for two.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop is 10, going backward. From 63, 2 hops land on 43.
widget.successFeedback: 43 — two tens walked back toward zero, landing on the difference.

predict.prompt: Subtracting on the line moves which way?
predict.reveal: Taking away shrinks the number, and smaller always lives to the left — 9 − 4 or 90 − 40, both walks head leftward.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2l jump sub.
invariants: Position on the line IS the number: equal jumps cover equal amounts, and a journey's landing depends only on start, jump size, and direction for g2l jump sub.
misconceptions: Treating marks as decoration — unequal spacing, jumps of the wrong size, or reading a start mark as a landing.

explanationVariants: The walk drops from 74 to 34, a distance of 40 — that is 4 ten-hops.
Divide the total drop by ten to count the hops: 40 ÷ 10 = 4.

widget.prompt: Jumping backward by tens, 74 lands on 34. How many ten-hops was that?

commonErrors.feedback: 40 is how far the walk traveled, not how many ten-hops that took — 40 ÷ 10 = 4 hops.
34 is where the walk landed, not how many hops it took — from 74 down to 34 is 4 ten-hops.

explanationVariants: A difference can be a walk OR a gap.

widget.prompt: Which drawing shows the gap between 54 and 34?

options.label: Drawing B
options.feedback: Forward jumps grow the number; a difference either walks BACK or measures the gap.

options.label: Drawing C
options.feedback: That mark is the ANSWER, but a drawing of the difference must show where it came from.

options.label: Drawing A
options.feedback: Correct — the difference is the distance separating the two marks, hopped and counted.

options.label: Drawing D
options.feedback: Adding the endpoints measures no distance at all — the gap between them is the difference.

hints: The difference is the space between.
